GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 628 (27 Jan 50) ESS/PF
(SCAPIN-2076)
APO 500
27 January 1950
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
Subject : Provision of Additional Dependent Housing for Occupation Forces
1. The Japanese Government will take immediate steps to construct 2,000 houses for rental to occupation force personnel. The houses, including necessary utilities, will be constructed at such places as may be instructed by and in accordance with plans and specifications approved by the Engineer Section, General Headquarters, Far East Command. The houses are to be constructed and rented by a Japanese Gevernment corporation established for such purposes.
2. Funds for the construction of the houses will be provided from the United States Aid Counterpart Fund as a loan to the corporation. Cost of furnishing, maintaining, and operating the housing will be borne by the Termination of War appropriation. Rentals will be paid to the corporation by occupants in such manner and amounts as may be determined by General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers.
3. The Japanese Government will prepare and present to the Economic and Scientific Section by 15 February 1950 such plans for action as may be required; to effectuate this directive.
4. Action to implement this directive is to be taken in accodance with the following schedule:
1 Feb 50 to 1 Mar 50 - Arrangements for financing, and beginning of contract regulations
1 March to 1 April - Finalization of building plans and betting of contracts
1 April - Beginning of construction
1 August - Completion of construction.
5. Direct communication with appropriate agencies of General Headquarters is authorized.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
K.B.Bush
Brigadier General, USA,
Adjutant General.
